response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, leadership, and architecture across multiple domains, but his background is heavily weighted toward web/mobile development and Dlang/TypeScript rather than C++ and cloud infrastructure. His experience with distributed systems (micro-services, high-performance I/O) is relevant, but lacks direct cloud compute platform leadership. His mentorship and community involvement are strong positives.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship with experience in TDD, CI/CD, and performance optimization
Proven leadership in mentoring teams and setting engineering best practices (e.g., Refactoring Dojos, Selenium course)
Diverse technical background with expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and DevOps tooling
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++ in the last decade (primary use was 2014-2015 at National Instruments)
No explicit experience with cloud compute platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) as a lead architect
Lacks production-level cloud architecture experience balancing short- and long-term needs
